title: SdrProposeRequest
description: Proposes one change to the committed design. Checks run on the design the change would produce, and gates decide whether it commits; until it commits, nothing has changed. The harness records you as its author and bases it on the design version you were shown. A value that a tool measured names that tool result's evidence id as its source.

reason.description: Why the design changes this way.

final.description: True only for the design you intend to stop on. The task can succeed only when a final change commits and every requirement it must satisfy has passing checks on that change. A final change may need a human's approval before it commits. A final change that commits without every check passing does not end the task.
